about_short_description.short_description: Together Software provides corporate mentor ship management platform.

product.name: Together Mentoring Software Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that facilitates the creation, management, and scaling of corporate mentorship programs by matching mentors and mentees and providing tools for session planning and impact measurement.

product.name: Mentorship
product.description: A structured program within the platform that matches individuals with experienced mentors to support professional development and learning.

product.name: Colleague Connect
product.description: A feature enabling informal, peer-to-peer learning by encouraging spontaneous interactions and knowledge sharing among colleagues.

product.name: Coffee Chats
product.description: A feature that facilitates casual virtual coffee meetings to build community and connect peers regularly within an organization.

product.name: AI-Enabled Mentorship
product.description: AI tools that personalize mentorship by generating profiles, suggesting discussion topics, and adapting to users’ learning needs while ensuring data privacy.

product.name: Badges & Certificates
product.description: A system to recognize and award participants with badges or certificates for achieving milestones or completing mentorship programs.
